1. if no curly braces - scope is global

1. Primitve - Numbers, strings, Boolean, Null, undefined, SYmbol and BigInt
Boolean = true or false -> truthy nature of the expression
null = no value -> we have declared the variable but no value is stored
undefined = we have declared a variable but we have not assigned a value to it
Objects - which is collection of different types of data.
Arrays - collection of data, index based.
[1,2,"JS", [3,4]] - In JS his will work fine
[1,2,"JS"] - it will give an error for strictly typed language
addition(+), multiplication(*), division(/) and subtraction(-), modulo(%),
1. == - to validate if the value is equal
2. === - to validate if the value and the data type
1. && (AND) - left and right both values are true
2. || (OR) - any of the left and right values is true
